name: true-to-essence-a-world-of-its-own
label: A world of its own.
description: Brought across from a page made elsewhere; every word, picture and link is a field.

content.text: True To Essence is part of The Arts of Becoming, and it lives in its own home, with its own portfolio, sessions and way of working.

Here, the camera becomes more than documentation. It becomes mirror, witness, stage, archive and play. Rather than asking you to perform for the camera, I create space for you to move, explore, play, feel, relate + be seen, to make images that feel like you.
